chunks: Say: "The angel of death appointed over you will take away your soul, then you will be sent back to your Lord."
ai.seo_question: Who takes the soul at death and where do we go afterwards according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the inevitability of death as a divine decree, with the Angel of Death acting as the faithful executor of God's command. It highlights the transitional phase between the soul's extraction and the final return to the Lord, emphasizing accountability in the context of the Hereafter.
